about.title: About
about.p1: PreBell publishes a short premarket brief every US trading day before the open: index futures, the biggest premarket movers and why they moved, and what to watch.
about.p2: Every brief is generated automatically from public market data and news. Numbers are checked against the source data before publishing, and each brief lists its sources. Times are US Eastern.
about.p3: English is published first; the Chinese version follows.

disclaimer: This brief is generated automatically from public data for information only. It is not investment advice.

earnings.legend: Confirmed: the company announced the date. Unconfirmed: the date comes from an aggregator and may change. Reported: the results are filed with the SEC.
earnings.chartsNote: Charts show GAAP figures from SEC filings; the last bar marked 8-K is this release. A gap means the company did not report that quarter separately.
